Subject: Re: Vector DB options & timeline for embeddings/rerank migration

Thanks for the context. High level notes from infra/implementation perspective:

- Vector DB choices:
  * Pinecone (hosted): easiest operationally, strong snapshot/restore, but higher unit cost and less control over shard topology. Good fit if Acme wants minimal ops.
  * Milvus/Weaviate (self-hosted on EKS): more cost-effective at scale, full control over scaling and snapshot cadence; requires cluster ops and careful compaction strategy for frequent writes.
  * Hybrid approach: Redwood serves embeddings and staging index, then we export snapshots to a customer-managed DB for production reads.

- Backfill orchestration options we can offer:
  1) Redwood-managed backfill: Redwood runs a stateful job in our dedicated environment that streams embeddings -> vector DB and provides retry/monitoring. Pros: minimal customer ops; Cons: data egress considerations (we can support via VPN/VPC peering).
  2) Customer-run backfill with runbook: we provide runbook + idempotent workers, a throttling profile, and a CloudFormation/EKS job template. Pros: customer control, data remains in their VPC.

- Backfill sizing estimate: 12M docs x avg 800 tokens -> ~9.6B tokens. At 200 docs/sec (safe default) embedding + indexing pass ~17 hours. If you want to keep it <8 hours we need ~450 docs/sec parallelism and bump infra. We will validate after we profile a 10k sample.

- Rerank eval suggestions:
  * Metrics: MRR@10, NDCG@10, Precision@5, latency P95 for rerank step.
  * Harness: run A/B over a fixed holdout set (5k queries) with labeled positives (derived from clicks/CTR + manual annotation).
  * Acceptance criteria: NDCG lift >= 7% and MRR lift >= 10% at parity latency (P95 increase < 15%).

I’ll attach a first-draft runbook + a vector DB comparison PDF.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference

Great alignment. I sketched a 6-week onboarding sprint and owners below — please confirm if this matches Acme’s priorities.

Week 0 (Prep, this week)
- Confirm QPS targets and concurrency: Samira (ACME) — due Tue 5/5 (status: pending)
- Share 10k sample dataset & labels: ACME — due Tue 5/5 (status: pending)

Week 1–2 (Pilot + Profiling)
- Redwood: profile embeddings throughput on sample, validate embedding size and cost estimate (Dev)
- Redwood/ACME: evaluate vector DB latency on 10k sample (joint)

Week 3 (Backfill dry run)
- Redwood-managed dry run: small-scale backfill to a staging vector DB; validate snapshot/restore and compaction behavior (Dev + Monica)

Week 4 (Rerank eval)
- Run rerank harness on holdout queries, compute MRR/NDCG and produce an A/B analysis (Monica leads)

Week 5–6 (Cutover & Monitoring)
- Gradual rollout: candidate generation -> rerank for 10% queries -> 50% -> 100% if metrics stable
- Post-cutover: 2-week monitoring window, automated alerts on regression

Owners & contacts:
- CS lead / Handoff owner: Monica Patel (monica@redwood.inference)
- Infra / Backfill: Dev Patel (dev@redwood.inference)
- Eval & Quality: Neha Kapoor (neha@redwood.inference)

Acceptance gates (suggested):
- Pilot: successful staging backfill + snapshot restore test
- Eval: NDCG >= +7% vs baseline and no more than 15% increase in rerank P95
- Ops: SLOs met for 95th tail latency at 200 QPS

Attachments: rerank-eval-plan.xlsx (evaluation sampling and labeling template)

Thanks — happy to run an internal kickoff with ACME and an exposed playbook we can check off.

— Monica
